title: [AINews] High Taste Testers Ep. 1
description: a quiet day lets us pilot a new show
summary: We are piloting a new show on Latent Space: High Taste Testers, a variant of our food show where we pull you in to a typical lunch conversation in San Francisco. All your favorite talking points, starting with Dev Day and going into the latest models and assistants, are here: Let us know your feedback!
takeaways: Weak spot : It ranks last among the top nine open models on AA’s four agentic evals while leading open models on AA-Omniscience.

Ecosystem : mlx-lm had day-0 support with vision, plus an Apple blog post on RDMA-distributed inference across Mac Studios ( @zcbenz ). vLLM served RL rollouts during Muse training and supports the release at launch ( vLLM ).

Architecture : Sliding-window attention with a 512 window in a 5:1 pattern, no RoPE, Llama-4-style global attention scaling, gated attention, QK-norm, sandwich norm, logit softcapping and no shared experts ( @eliebakouch ).
